The Maverik is our best-selling laptop bag: a slim, structured office bag in premium glazed cow leather with a smooth, polished surface and natural lustre. It carries a laptop, documents and the small things of a working day, and still looks sharp in a meeting.

What it carries

  • 1 padded laptop compartment for laptops up to 14.5 inches
  • 3 small organiser slots for pens, cards and cables
  • 1 front pocket
  • 1 back zip pocket
  • Removable, adjustable shoulder strap
  • Measures 15.2" L x 12" H x 2.5" W
  • Colours: Burgundy, Black and Tan

Who it is for

For managers, bankers, consultants and anyone who carries a laptop to work every day. It is also a popular choice for team and client gifts, and we can add your company logo on bulk orders.

Care

Wipe with a soft dry cloth, keep it out of rain and direct heat for long periods, and condition it with a little leather balm every few months. Real leather softens and darkens slowly with use, which is the point.

Questions we get

Will my laptop fit?
The padded compartment takes laptops up to 14.5 inches. For a larger laptop, see the Extendable Travel Laptop Bag, which takes most laptops up to 15.5 inches.

Can we order several for our team?
Yes. We offer corporate pricing on bulk orders and logo debossing on 10 or more pieces. Message us on WhatsApp.

Delivery, payment and warranty

Handcrafted in Pakistan from genuine leather, never coated synthetic. Cash on delivery is available across Pakistan, delivery is free on orders over Rs 5,500, and every piece is covered by our lifetime craftsmanship warranty on stitching and hardware. Need a measurement or a closer look at a colour? Message us on WhatsApp at 0333 2601161.

A genuine leather western hat built to be packed, sat on and pulled back into shape. The crushable crown takes a fold without creasing permanently, which makes this the one to own if your hat lives in a car, a bag or the back of a bike.

Details

  • 100% genuine leather, soft full-grain hide
  • Crushable and packable: reshapes after folding
  • Shaped brim that holds its curve
  • Lightweight for a full day in the sun

How to choose your size

  • S: 20 to 21.5 inches
  • M: 21.5 to 22.5 inches
  • L: 22.5 to 23 inches
  • XL: 23 inches and above

Measure around your head just above the ears and eyebrows. Between two sizes, pick the larger one.

Care

Wipe with a soft dry cloth, keep it out of rain and direct heat for long periods, and condition it with a little leather balm every few months. Real leather softens and darkens slowly with use, which is the point.

Questions we get

Will it lose its shape if I fold it?
No. The crown is made to fold for travel and push back into shape when you take it out.

Is it good for travel?
Yes. It is our most packable hat, made for road trips and the northern areas.

Delivery, payment and warranty

Handcrafted in Pakistan from genuine leather, never coated synthetic. Cash on delivery is available across Pakistan, delivery is free on orders over Rs 5,500, and every piece is covered by our lifetime craftsmanship warranty on stitching and hardware.
